title: Dasharatha prepares the ashvamedha
introduction: King Dasharatha requests the Sages to conduct the Vedic ritual for which the sages indent paraphernalia, which the ministers are ordered to supply forthwith. This chapter is almost a replication of chapter 8, excepting the inclusion of references to Sage Rishyasringa who by now is available in Ayodhya.
closing: The Indian yearly time-cycle is two-kind, one on northern solstice and the other southern solstice. And seasons are twelve and every two months is a season, and they are calculated by almanacs basing on the stars position every year. They roughly compare with the following Gregorian months as below:
इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्वादशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 12th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततः काले बहुतिथे कस्मिंश्चित्सुमनोहरे |
वसन्ते समनुप्राप्ते राज्ञो यष्टुं मनोऽभवत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ kāle bahu tithe kasmin cit sumanohare |
vasante samanuprāpte rājño yaṣṭum mano'bhavat
verses.translation: After a lapse some time when spring season has come the king Dasharatha desired to perform the Vedic ritual.
notes: Please refer to endnote for Indian seasons and months for vasanta / spring season.

glosses.meaning: on the arrival of that spring

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रसाद्य शिरसा तं विप्रं देववर्णिनम् |
यज्ञाय वरयामास संतानार्थं कुलस्य च
verses.iast:
tataḥ praṇaṃya śirasā tam vipram deva varṇinam |
yajñāya varayāmāsa santāna artham kulasya ca
tatha iti ca sa rājānam uvāca vasudha adhipam |
verses.translation: Then bowing his head before that Brahmana sage Rishyasringa whose is glow is like that of a deity, King Dasharatha verily beseeched that sage to conduct Vedic ritual on his behalf as he wished to beget progeny to maintaining his family line.

verses.devanagari:
तथेति च स राजानमुवाच च सुसत्कृतः |
संभाराः संभ्रियन्तां ते तुरगश्च विमुच्यताम्
सरव्याश्चोत्तरे तीरे यज्ञभूमिर्विधीयताम् |
verses.iast:
sambhārāḥ sambhriyantām te turagaśca vimucyatām
saravyāḥ ca uttare tīre yajña bhūmiḥ vidhīyatām |
verses.translation: Sage Rishyasringa who by now is well-honoured by the king said to the king, "So it shall be, let the paraphernalia for ritual be garnered and let your ritual horse be released as a prerogative."

verses.devanagari:
ततो नृपोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रिसत्तमम्
सुमंत्रावाहय क्षिप्रमृत्विजो ब्रह्मवादिनः |
सुयज्ञं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ काश्यपम्
पुरोहितं वसिष्ठं च ये चान्ये द्विजसत्तमाः |
verses.iast:
tato abravīt nṛpaḥ vākyam brāhmaṇān veda pāragān
sumantra āvāhaya kśṣipram ṛtvijo brahma vādinaḥ |
suyajñam vāmadevam ca jābālim atha kāśyapam
purohitam vasiṣṭham ca ye ca anye dvija sattamāḥ |
verses.translation: Then King Dasharatha said to his best minister Sumantra, "Let the Vedic scholars and ritual conductors like Sages Suyajna, Vaamadeva, Jaabaali, and Kaashyapa, along with the family priest Vashishta, as well as other Vedic Brahmans that are there, they all be invited swiftly..."

verses.devanagari:
ततः सुमंत्रस्त्वरितं गत्वा त्वरितविक्रमः
समानयत्स तान्सर्वान् समस्तान्वेदपारगान् |
तान् पूजयित्वा धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथस्तदा
धर्मार्थसहितं युक्तं श्लक्ष्णं वचनमब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ sumantraḥ tvaritam gatvā tvarita vikramaḥ
samānayat sa tān sarvān samastān veda pāragān |
tān pUjayitvā dharmātmā rājā daśarathaḥ tadā
dharma artha sahitam yuktam ślakśṇam vacanam abravIt |
verses.translation: Then Sumantra being a quickest person went quickly and fetched all those Vedic scholars and clerj~nmen. Then the virtuous king Dasharatha having offered due worships to all the sages and saints brought in by Sumantra, uttered these words which are with virtue and meaning, in an impressible manner.

glosses.meaning: them, all of the, Vedic scholars

verses.devanagari:
मम लालप्यमानस्य पुत्रार्थं नास्ति वै सुखम्
तदर्थं हयमेधेन यक्ष्यामीति मतिर्मम |
तदहं यष्टुमिच्छामि शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा
ऋषिपुत्रप्रभावेण कामान्प्राप्स्यामि चाप्यहम् |
verses.iast:
mama tātapya mānasya putrārtham nāsti vai sukham
putrārtham hayamedhena yakśayāmi iti matirmama |
tat aham yaṣṭum icchāmi hayamedhena karmaṇā
ṛṣiputra prabhāveṇa kāmān prāpsyāmi ca api aham |
verses.translation: "My mind is tumultuous without quietude for I have no sons... hence I am thinking of performing the Vedic Horse Ritual for progeny... I wish to perform the ritual as enshrined in the scriptures and by strict observances... I wish to get my desires fulfilled through the divine influence of the Sage's son, Rishyasringa...

verses.devanagari:
ततः साध्विति तद्वाक्यं ब्राह्मणाः प्रत्यपूजयन्
वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः सर्वे पार्थिवस्य मुखाच्च्युतम् |
ऋष्यशृङ्गपुरोगाश्च प्रत्यूचुर्नृपतिं तदा
verses.iast:
tataḥ sādhu iti tad vākyam brāhmaṇāḥ pratyapUjayan
vasiśhṭha pramukhāḥ sarve pārthivasya mukhāt cyutam |
ṛṣyaśṛñga purogāḥ ca prati ūcuḥ nṛpatim tadā
verses.translation: Then "Splendid, splendid is this idea," said the Brahmana scholars blessing the king. Then Sage Vashishta along with all other important personalities have applauded the idea that has come out of the king's voice, and all those Vedic scholars and clerj~nmen keeping Rishyasringa at helm of affairs said this to the king, in appreciation of that idea.

verses.devanagari:
संभाराः संभ्रियन्तां ते तुरगश्च विमुच्यताम् |
सरव्याश्चोत्तरे तीरे यज्ञभूमिर्विधीयताम्
सर्वथा प्राप्यसे पुत्रांश्चतुरोऽमितविक्रमान् |
यस्य ते धार्मिकी बुद्धिरियं पुत्रार्थमागता
verses.iast:
sambhārāḥ sambhriyamtām te turagaḥ ca vimucyatām |
saravyāḥ ca uttare tīre yajña bhūmiḥ vidhīyatām
sarvathā prāpyase putrām caturo amita vikramān |
yasya te dharmikī buddhiḥ iyam putrārtham āgatā
verses.translation: "Because a virtuous thinking of begetting sons through Vedic ritual has come to you, you will by all means get four sons with boundless valour... let ritual paraphernalia be garnered and let your ritual-horse be released..." The Vedic seers thus blessed Dasharatha.

glosses.meaning: this kind of, virtuous, thinking, has come

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रीतोऽभवद्राजा श्रुत्वा तत् द्विजभाषितम् |
अमात्यांश्चाब्रवीद्राजा हर्षेणेदं शुभाक्षरम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ prīto'bhavat rājā śrutvā tu dvija bhāṣitam |
amātyān abravīt rājā harśheṇa idam śubha akśaram
verses.translation: Then the king is gladdened to hear the blessing advises of the Vedic scholars, and he spoke to the other ministers of his court, with happiness derived from those good words.

glosses.meaning: those, Brahmanas, that is said by them

verses.devanagari:
गुरूणां वचनाच्छीघ्रं संभाराः संभ्रियन्तु मे |
समर्थाधिष्ठितश्चाश्वः सोपाध्यायो विमुच्यताम्
सरयव्याश्चोत्तरे तीरे यज्ञभूमिर्विधीयताम् |
शांतयश्चाभिवर्धन्तां यथाकल्पं यथाविधि
शक्यः कर्तुमयं यज्ञः सर्वेणापि महीक्षिता |
नापराधो भवेत्कष्टो यद्यस्मिन् क्रतुसत्तमे
छिद्रं हि मृगयन्तेऽत्र विद्वांसो ब्रह्मराक्षसाः |
विघ्नितस्य हि यज्ञस्य सद्यः कर्ता विनश्यति
तद्यथा विधिपूर्वं मे क्रतुरेष समाप्यते |
तथा विधानं क्रियतां समर्थाः करणेष्विह
verses.iast:
gurUṇām vacanāt śīghram sambhārāḥ sambhriyantu me |
samartha adhiśhṭitaḥ ca aśvaḥ saḥ upādhyāyo vimucyatām
sarayavyāḥ ca uttare tīre yajña bhUmiḥ vidhIyatām |
śāntayaḥ ca abhivarthantām yathā kalpam yathā vidhi
śakyaḥ kartum ayam yajñaḥ sarveṇa api mahīkśitā |
na aparātho bhavet kaśhṭo yadya asmin kratu sattame
chidram hi mṛgayanta ete vidvānso brahma rākśasāḥ |
vidhihīnasya yajñasya sadyaḥ kartā vinaśyati
tad yathā vidhi pūrvam kratuḥ eṣa samāpyate |
tathā vidhānam kriyatām samarthāḥ karaṇeṣu iha
verses.translation: The king said to his executives, "As advised by my Vedic teachers, let the paraphernalia for my ritual be procured... let the ritual-horse be released, guarded well by gallant men in its journey... and let religious teachers follow that horse as per tradition... let the ritual place be decided on the northern banks of Sarayu River... let the peace invocations be prevailing and prospering throughout as ordained in the scriptures and tradition... all the kings on this earth would have performed this Horse Ritual, if only they can perform this without a mistake... thus, this is a great and difficult ritual... the Brahma-demons will be hunting for the faults performed in the rituals whereat they can inteject themselves in to the proceedings of the ritual in order to ruin it... further, the performer of the ritual also gets ruined if there were be to be faults... that is why this ritual shall be conducted faultlessly till its conclusion, and with absolute adherence to the scriptures... since all of you assembled here are efficient ones in conducting such rituals without faults, I hope you all will organise carefully....

glosses.meaning: in affairs, here, [so said the king to Vedic scholars]

verses.devanagari:
तथेति च ततः सर्वे मंत्रिणः प्रत्यपूजयन् |
पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य तद्वाक्यं यथाज्ञप्तमकुर्वत
verses.iast:
tathā iti ca tataḥ sarve mantriṇaḥ pratyapūjayan |
pārthiva indrasya tat vākyam yathā ājñaptam akurvata
verses.translation: In appreciation of his orders all the ministers replied the king saying "it will be done accordingly..." and indeed they have faultlessly carried out works as ordered.

verses.devanagari:
ततो द्विजास्ते धर्मज्ञमस्तुवन्पार्थिवर्षभम् |
अनुज्ञातास्ततः सर्वे पुनर्जग्मुर्यथागतम्
verses.iast:
tato dvijāḥ te dharmajñam astuvan pārthivarṣabham |
anujñātāḥ tataḥ sarve punaḥ jagmuḥ yathā āgatam
verses.translation: Then all the Brahmans applauded the virtuous king and who is like a Sacred Bull among the kings for his virtuous endeavour of undertaking the Vedic ritual, and with his permission all of them returned from there as they have come.

verses.devanagari:
गतेष्वथ द्विजाग्र्येषु मंत्रिणस्तान्नराधिपः |
विसर्जयित्वा स्वं वेश्म प्रविवेश महाद्युतिः
verses.iast:
gateṣu teṣu vipreṣu mantriṇaḥ tān narādhipaḥ |
visarjayitvā svam veśma praviveśa mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: On the departure of the prominent Brahmans, King Dasharatha sent off those ministers who are still available there for further orders from the king, and then he the great resplendent king has entered his own palace.
